<b>Surgeons</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are physicians of the [[Whiteward]], responsible for operations and modifications on the [[Citadel]]'s bugs.<ref>Surgeon [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Cruel physician of Whiteward, responsible for operations and modifications on the Citadel's bugs."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Surgeons do not walk, and can only reposition using the following moves:
* <b>Jump:</b> Performs a slow, floaty jump towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. The Surgeon can suddenly use Pin Flurry whilst midair during this move.
* <b>Pin Flurry:</b> Briefly extends pins attached to its body by [[Silk]] threads, then lashes out with them in a large semicircle around itself, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught at any point during the attack.
* <b>Reposition:</b> Sinks into the ground, and after a second, a dust cloud indicates where it reappears as it shoots its pins upwards to pull itself out, emerging either near or beneath Hornet.

Due to their predictable attacks and slow movement, Surgeons can simply be baited into attacking and then quickly counterattacked.

* None may die! None may die!

== Location ==
Surgeons can be found in the [[Whiteward]], specifically in a room unlocked during the <i>[[Balm for the Wounded]]</i> [[wish]]. Three of them are fought alongside two [[Mortician]]s as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Whiteward 1|enemy gauntlet]]. In [[Act 3]], two Surgeons can be found there. They respawn upon leaving and re-entering the room, making them one of the rare enemies that drop rosaries but don't require resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] to respawn.

== Trivia ==
* The voice of a Surgeon can be heard on the [[Psalm Cylinder]] that records the last surgery of [[Conductors#Mizello|Conductor Mizello]].
* In the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, Surgeons can be seen wandering rooms in the [[Choral Chambers]].<ref>[https://youtu.be/pFAknD_9U7c?t=102 Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> However, in the final release, they are relegated to a single enemy gauntlet within the Whiteward.
